iterations.title: Convergence — FOYER v4 (Atrium body · Threshold grammar · fork soul)
iterations.note: Judges: requirements 8/7/4 · interaction: Atrium base + Threshold grammar + V2 raises · craft: 5 fixes applied and vision-verified. Research: 'Foyer' = gdeyoung/omarchy-foyer v0.4.2 (fork DNA ported verbatim); KDE surface = LayerShellQt + enableBlurBehind + dbus warm start. Council (ai-tech): deterministic core first, AI lane explicit-Enter only, answers read-only — folded. All data real: live ICMP probe (13 UP · nas DOWN), .desktop scan, ssh config, hermes-runner config.
